description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance Call Out with effect from April 2, 2022 all the members of the Armed Forces
categorisation: This gazette content involves the President exercising powers under the Public Security Ordinance to call out armed forces for maintaining public order. This constitutes a legal/regulatory action involving statutory instruments and the implementation of existing legislation (Chapter 40), rather than government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or any of the other specialized categories. The content focuses on the legal authority and implementation of security measures through established ordinances.
